newsitem.title: USA: Material Sciences closes $50 mln placement.
newsitem.headline: Material Sciences closes $50 mln placement.

text.p: Material Sciences Corp said Wednesday it completed a private placement for $50 million of 7.05 percent senior unsecured notes due 2007.
The company said it will use the proceeds from the private placement to refinance existing debt, repurchase its common stock, and for general corporate purposes.

In late December, the board of Material Sciences authorized the repurchase of one million of the company's shares. To date, about 25 percent of the one million shares has been bought back. Material Sciences has about 15.6 million shares outstanding.
Shares of Material Sciences, which makes specialty coated materials, were trading up 1/8 to 17-1/4.
